skill.name: docs-write
skill.description: Create and edit Markdown or MDX documentation using Metabase's clear, conversational, and user-focused style.
skill.summary: Write focused Metabase documentation with direct instructions, descriptive headings, and consistent formatting.
skill.author: metabase

content.value_statement: Technical documentation often becomes formal, vague, or difficult to scan. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code write clear Metabase documentation with focused steps.
actual_capabilities: Drafts and edits Markdown or MDX documentation for Metabase.
Leads with actions before explaining reasons or context.
Creates descriptive headings that state the main point.
Formats links, code terms, and interface labels consistently.
Applies a repository formatter after documentation edits.
limitations: The referenced shared style guide must exist at the expected relative path.
The skill cannot guarantee technical accuracy without reliable project context.
The guidance is specialized for Metabase documentation conventions.
Formatting requires Bun and the repository dependencies.

use_cases.title: Draft Feature Documentation
use_cases.description: Turn verified feature details into a focused guide with clear steps and expected results.

use_cases.title: Improve Product Guides
use_cases.description: Rewrite dense or formal documentation so customers can find and complete tasks faster.

use_cases.title: Standardize Documentation Changes
use_cases.description: Apply Metabase wording, formatting, and heading conventions during code-related documentation updates.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Short Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a short Metabase documentation page for [feature]. Explain the audience, prerequisites, steps, and expected result in clear Markdown.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a beginner-friendly page from verified feature details.

prompt_templates.title: Rewrite Existing Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite the following documentation in Metabase style: [text]. Lead with actions, simplify formal language, and use descriptive headings and links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve the clarity and tone of an existing page.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Task Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a task guide for [workflow] using these verified details: [details]. Separate each action from its explanation and format interface labels in bold.
prompt_templates.scenario: Document a multistep workflow for product users.

prompt_templates.title: Audit and Revise a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [file] for Metabase style, clarity, structure, link text, interface formatting, and working examples. Revise it, summarize material changes, then run the repository formatter.
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete an advanced editorial and formatting pass.

output_examples.input: Replace the vague heading Environment variables.
Turn a dense paragraph about SAML setup into actionable steps.
output: Configure SAML with the verified identity provider settings.

output_examples.input: Improve a generic link label that says Read here.
output_examples.output: Check the SAML documentation for configuration requirements.

best_practices: Provide verified product details, audience needs, and prerequisites.
Review every example and link before publishing.
Run the repository formatter after content changes.
anti_patterns: Do not bury required actions inside long explanatory paragraphs.
Do not use vague headings or generic link labels.
Do not describe tasks as easy or include facts that will quickly expire.

faq.question: What documentation formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports creating and editing Markdown, MDX, and similar text documentation.

faq.question: Can it rewrite an existing documentation page?
faq.answer: Yes. It can improve structure, tone, headings, links, and formatting while preserving verified meaning.

faq.question: Does it check technical correctness?
faq.answer: It directs the assistant to verify examples, but reliable project context is still required for factual validation.

faq.question: Will it change documentation files?
faq.answer: It can create or edit requested files and run Prettier when Bun and repository dependencies are available.

faq.question: Does it require internet access?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains no network instructions and uses local documentation context.

faq.question: Can it apply style guides outside Metabase?
faq.answer: Its principles are reusable, but its wording and formatting guidance specifically targets Metabase documentation.
